device.name: Fronius Solar Inverter (Solar API V1)
device.notes:
Fronius solar inverters and dataloggers (Datamanager/Hybridmanager on Snap inverters and Symo Hybrid; GEN24 / Tauro / Verto) expose a local JSON REST API — the Solar API V1 — for telemetry. It is read-only and, notably, unauthenticated: the API answers regardless of the user/admin password. On GEN24 the API has an enable/disable switch (enable it in the inverter web UI); older platforms answer by default.
NEGOTIATION: GET /solar_api/GetAPIVersion.cgi returns {"APIVersion":1,"BaseURL":"/solar_api/v1/","CompatibilityRange":"1.5-9"}.
ENDPOINTS under /solar_api/v1/: GetInverterRealtimeData.cgi, GetInverterInfo, GetActiveDeviceInfo, GetMeterRealtimeData, GetStorageRealtimeData, GetOhmPilotRealtimeData, GetPowerFlowRealtimeData, GetLoggerInfo, and GetArchiveData.cgi for history. Requests use Scope=System|Device, DeviceId=<Solar Net address>, DataCollection= (e.g. CommonInverterData). Responses are JSON with a common Head (status codes, timestamps) and a Body.
TRANSPORT: HTTP on Datamanager and older GEN24 (< 1.35); GEN24 >= 1.35 adds HTTPS with a Fronius-generated (untrusted) certificate, and redirects requests from non-private IPs to HTTPS while allowing plain HTTP from RFC1918 ranges. GEN24 reports null for several legacy DAY_ENERGY-style values.

openness.notes: Vendor-documented and vendor-supported; nothing here was reverse- engineered. An OpenAPI/Swagger spec for GEN24/Tauro/Verto is also officially downloadable from Fronius.

upstream_docs.title: Fronius — Solar API (JSON)

credentials.notes: The Solar API is unauthenticated by design (it answers regardless of the set passwords). Network onboarding is via the device's own web UI, not this API.

factory_reset.effect: A datalogger reset returns it to setup; the gesture is in Fronius's own documentation and not transcribed here. The Solar API stores no user credential (it is unauthenticated).

methods.description: Join the inverter/datalogger to the network via its web UI, and on GEN24 enable the Solar API in the inverter's Site Communication settings. The API then answers under /solar_api/v1/ with no auth.

steps.action: Network the inverter/datalogger via its own web UI.
On GEN24, enable the Solar API in the inverter web UI.

setup.notes: The datalogger/inverter joins the LAN via its own web UI / setup AP. On GEN24 the Solar API must be enabled in the inverter web UI (Site Communication). No account is needed for local reads.

rejoin.notes: Network settings are changed from the inverter/datalogger web UI in place.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. Endpoints, the no-auth property and the GEN24 enable/HTTPS behaviour are paraphrased from the official Fronius Solar API V1 documentation.
